The only places that have to be touched for a TensorFlow DPR implementation are the core package init, the TF‑auto‑model registry, the TF checkpoint conversion utilities, the dummy TF objects needed for the new model and the new TF DPR model file itself (plus the documentation stub).  

**Files that need to be added or edited**

| File | Reason for change |
|------|-------------------|
| `src/transformers/__init__.py` | Add imports for the new TF‑DPR classes (`TFDPRContextEncoder`, `TFDPRQuestionEncoder`, `TFDPRReader`, and their pretrained‑model‑archive maps). |
| `src/transformers/modeling_tf_auto.py` | Extend `TF_MODEL_MAPPING` (and `TF_MODEL_WITH_LM_HEAD_MAPPING` if needed) with the DPR model‑to‑class entries so `TFAutoModel…` can discover the TF DPR models. |
| `src/transformers/convert_pytorch_checkpoint_to_tf2.py` | Register the DPR components in the conversion logic (add the DPR encoder/reader cases) so that a PyTorch DPR checkpoint can be turned into a TF checkpoint. |
| `src/transformers/utils/dummy_tf_objects.py` | Provide any missing TensorFlow placeholder layers (e.g., a dummy `TFEmbedding` or `TFLinear`) that the new DPR model relies on but are not present in the TF code base. |
| `src/transformers/modeling_tf_dpr.py` *(new file)* | Full TensorFlow implementation of the DPR context encoder, question encoder and reader, mirroring `modeling_dpr.py`. |
| `docs/source/model_doc/dpr.rst` *(new file)* | Documentation page for the TF DPR models (mirrors the existing PyTorch DPR doc). |

These are the only files that must be created or modified to get a functional TensorFlow DPR integration and to make the PR pass the repository tests.
